claims.object_text: increased neurotransmitter and potassium ion levels at the synaptic cleft, which facilitates cortical spreading depolarization
claims.quote: Taken together, mutations in these three genes predict increased neurotransmitter and potassium ion levels at the synaptic cleft, which facilitates cortical spreading depolarization, the phenomenon underlying the migraine aura.
Three genes, CACNA1A, ATP1A2, and SCN1A have been identified.

claims.object_text: mild phenotype that is more akin to that of common (nonhemiplegic) migraine
claims.quote: Most patients with hemiplegic migraine without a mutation in CACNA1A, ATP1A2, or SCN1A display a mild phenotype that is more akin to that of common (nonhemiplegic) migraine.
